known_limitations: Farm Edit frontend UI is not implemented (backend PATCH exists and is tested)
Field initial-crop-selection frontend UI is not implemented (backend contract exists and is tested)
No real LLM/weather API integration -- all AI/weather providers are explicitly mocked by design
No field-edit UI for modifying an existing field's crop set (only initial creation)
No toast/notification component system -- inline banners used instead
V2 Plant Vision currently covers only Corn and Potato (7 classes); Rice, Wheat and Sugarcane remain deferred.
V2 internal held-out accuracy is 92.11%, but the PlantDoc real-world subset is 63.49% versus 95.13% on PlantVillage-style images, so the lab-to-field gap is not resolved.
V2 OOD rejection is not production-proven: combined rejection was 26.67% on the measured real off-taxonomy plant OOD set and 89% on synthetic non-plant/noise.
V2 training sources and licenses are documented in the ML reports; commercial distribution requires separate legal review of dataset/model licensing terms.

history.note: This section is HISTORICAL CONTEXT ONLY. Do not treat anything here as describing the current state -- see 'features' and 'backend'/'frontend' above for that.
history.environment_reset: The sandbox environment reset mid-project at one point; the working directory was lost and restored from the most recent prior ZIP export. That export predated Farm Edit frontend UI, field initial-crop-selection frontend UI, and (at the time) the entire visual/motion design overhaul. Backend portions of that gap were reconstructed and re-verified. The visual/motion overhaul was subsequently built from scratch in a later session and is now present (see features.visual_motion_overhaul) -- it was NOT restored from any lost prior version.
history.farm_edit_and_initial_crops_frontend: These two frontend pieces were never rebuilt after the reset and remain missing as of this snapshot -- this is current fact, not just history.

current_development_phase: V2-alpha Plant Vision model integrated for Corn/Potato; Scan and crop-linked Plant Vision use the same V2 inference service; Rice/Wheat/Sugarcane extension and real-world generalization remain open

roadmap_status.core_frontend_platform: Mostly complete (auth, farms list/create, fields, crops, activities, weather, risk scan, AI Crop Advisor, Plant Vision, Copilot all present and tested)
roadmap_status.real_ai_llm_provider: Not started (intentionally deferred, mock-first architecture in place)
roadmap_status.experimental_cnn_model: V1 is archived as a legacy reference. The production Plant Vision path now uses V2-alpha for Corn/Potato.
roadmap_status.v2_plant_disease_model: INTEGRATED AS ALPHA: 7-class Corn/Potato V2 model is wired into Plant Vision and Quick Scan. Internal held-out accuracy 92.11%; PlantVillage 95.13% vs PlantDoc 63.49%; combined OOD rejection 26.67% on real off-taxonomy plant images and 89% on synthetic non-plant/noise. Rice/Wheat/Sugarcane remain deferred. V2 is not yet field-validated or commercially cleared.
roadmap_status.note: Percentages are not used because they cannot be defensibly justified from the verified evidence; qualitative status only, per instruction. V2's percentages above are an exception -- they come from this session's own measured, leakage-gated evaluation, not from unverifiable prior evidence.
